objective: Create the governance-only, exact-byte pre-log package for the NarraTwin Authoritative Master Program, Cut 1 real-media delivery, and operational closeout controller. Preserve its full scope and exclusions, bind its bytes to a deterministic digest, expose three independent review surfaces, and keep all implementation, provider, paid-operation, audio, video, deployment, publication, release, and production authority blocked until this issue is reviewed, merged, verified on main, and closed.

forbidden: quality-checker or guardrail changes beyond exact Issue #424 bootstrap branch/path/budget recognition; workflow or repository-setting changes
dependencies, containers, provider SDKs, credentials, secret lookup, or egress
audio, video, captions, media binaries, renderer auditions, or paid operations
deployment, publication, release, public availability, or production-readiness claims
activation of ActiveProgramRouteV1 or Cut1AuthorityManifestV1 before merged-main closeout

claims.G424_01: One canonical Markdown controller preserves all forty-two numbered sections and their ordering.
claims.G424_02: A separate JSON record binds the controller path, byte count, no-trailing-newline state, SHA-256 digest, issue, branch, and base without creating a self-referential hash.
claims.G424_03: The controller remains planning and authority input only; no implementation route becomes active in this PR.
claims.G424_04: Cut 1 completion remains mechanically separate from full plug-and-play, hosted, production-durability, production-readiness, release, and public-availability claims.
claims.G424_05: Stale routes, placeholders, provider success payloads, one output, or machine-only media validation cannot satisfy real-media acceptance.
claims.G424_06: Provider selection, credentials, fallback, egress, and spend remain server-controlled, explicit, current, separately approved, and fail closed.
claims.G424_07: Cleanup remains inventory-scoped and cannot authorize deletion of unrelated user, workspace, evidence, cache, or infrastructure resources.
claims.G424_08: Every terminal handoff and completion claim remains evidence-bound and reports unresolved blockers and retained resources.
claims.G424_09: The next implementation child remains blocked until exact-byte OWNER approval, three review dispositions, exact-head non-author review, merge, merged-main checks, issue closeout, and a new active route.
claims.G424_10: Repository status remains No-Go and records zero provider calls, zero spend, and zero new media artifacts for this route.
claims.G424_11: The Stage 8 checker recognizes only the exact Issue #424 branch, twelve paths, and 8,500-line ceiling; near-match, extra-path, and over-budget mutations fail.

rollback: Before merge, close the PR unmerged and remove only its clean task branch/worktree and scoped temporary root. After merge, use a new issue, branch, and PR to revert the governance commit; retain historical evidence and never revive a superseded route implicitly.
